load packages

load object

fileNam <- "/Users/immbio/Desktop/HumanHeartCarTrans2/data/Human_heart_allmerged_seurat_clean.rds"

### diseaseCond
seuratM$diseaseCond <- "diseaseCond"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V1|V2|353921_12-12_20240515_Hu_nucseq_USZ_EMB010_V1_2", seuratM$dataset)] <- "PP"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V3", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit3"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V4", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit4"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V5", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit5"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("VX1|VX2|VX3|VX4", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visitX"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("HH", seuratM$dataset)] <- "Donorheart"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("RV|LV|expLV|expRV|331571_3-5_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx001|331571_4-6_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx002", seuratM$dataset)] <- "Explant"


table(seuratM$diseaseCond)

#coldiseaseCond <- c("#BEAED4", "#BE3144", "#dfc27d","#77DD77", "#a38995") 
#names(coldiseaseCond) <- c("Donorheart", "Explant", "PP", "CP", "RP")
order_keywords <- c("visit3", "visit4", "visit5", "visitX")
files <- unique(seuratM$patient_diseaseCond)
ordered_files <- c()
for (key in order_keywords) {
  ordered_files <- c(ordered_files, files[grepl(key, files)])
}

###patient_diseaseCond
datList <- NULL
for(con in unique(seuratM$patient_diseaseCond)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, patient_diseaseCond==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(patient_diseaseCond=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}

dat_all <- do.call("rbind", datList)

## plot abundance
ggbarplot(dat_all, x= "patient_diseaseCond", 
          y= "percent", fill = "Var1", 
          palette = colclusterName, legend = "right", 
          legend.titel = "cluster", 
          ylab = "frequency",
          )  + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + scale_x_discrete(limits=ordered_files)

dat_all <- as.data.frame(dat_all)

# Filter "T cell" cluster
dat_all_Tcell <- filter(dat_all, Var1 == "Tcell")

# Filter for visit 3, 4, 5 and X
dat_all_Tcell_sub <- dat_all_Tcell %>% filter(patient_diseaseCond %in% ordered_files)
table(dat_all_Tcell_sub)

conds_of_interest <- c("PP", "CP", "RP")
df <- seuratM@meta.data[seuratM$diseaseCond %in% conds_of_interest, ]

patients_per_phase <- df %>%
  filter(rejection == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient, diseaseCond) %>%  # only count each patient once per phase
  group_by(diseaseCond) %>%
  summarise(n_patients = n(), .groups = "drop")

patients_per_phase$diseaseCond <- factor(patients_per_phase$diseaseCond, 
                                         levels = c("PP", "CP", "RP"))

ggplot(patients_per_phase, aes(x = diseaseCond, y = n_patients, fill = diseaseCond)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = coldiseaseCond) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Disease Phase", y = "Number of Patients with Rejection",
       title = "Patients with Rejection per Disease Phase")

                              levels = c("Donorheart", "PP", "CP", "RP", "Explant"))

# Violin plot
VlnPlot(object = seuratM, features = "ENSG00000111537.IFNG", group.by = "diseaseCond",pt.size = 1,cols = colclusterName)
VlnPlot(object = seuratM, features = "ENSG00000145649.GZMA", group.by = "diseaseCond",pt.size = 1,cols = colclusterName)
VlnPlot(object = seuratM, features = "ENSG00000121807.CCR2", group.by = "diseaseCond",pt.size = 1,cols = colclusterName)
VlnPlot(object = seuratM, features = "ENSG00000232810.TNF", group.by = "diseaseCond",pt.size = 1,cols = colclusterName)
VlnPlot(object = seuratM, features = "ENSG00000136634.IL10", group.by = "diseaseCond",pt.size = 1,cols = colclusterName)

query_genes <- c("IFNG", "GZMA", "CCR2", "ENSG00000232810.TNF", "IL10")

sel_features <- grep(paste(query_genes, collapse = "|"), Features(seuratM), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

sorted_features <- sel_features[order(sub(".*\\.", "", sel_features))]
sorted_features <- c("ENSG00000111537.IFNG", "ENSG00000145649.GZMA", "ENSG00000121807.CCR2","ENSG00000232810.TNF", "ENSG00000136634.IL10")

for (feature in sorted_features) {
  feature_plot <- FeaturePlot(seuratM, features = feature, pt.size = 0.5, cols = c("lightgrey", "#BE3144"), raster = FALSE, order=TRUE)
  vln_plot <- VlnPlot(object = seuratM, features = feature, group.by = "diseaseCond") + theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  combined_plot <- feature_plot | vln_plot
  
  print(combined_plot)
}
